OFFICIAL RECAP: "Vlonely + Friends" Presented By Underground Raps & @vlonely.mp4 🎤 MORE SHOWS FOR CHICAGO ON THE WAY SOON 💙 Main Headliner: @thehxliday Footage: @josephisgonee & @thirdeyeviews_ Edited by @icproductions__

Thank you everyone who attended & was apart of the first Presented Underground Raps Show "Vlonely & Friends". You all made a dream of mine come true. I will continue to throw shows for y'all and give y'all a safe, fun space to express yourselves and enjoy yourself at. Bigger & better is on the way, this show will go down as history.
